sources.entry: Visit the website to search and filter projects more easily.

summary.name: Awesome Python
summary.one_liner: A searchable, categorized web guide to curated Python frameworks, libraries and tools, showing each project's description, download counts and GitHub stars.
use_cases: Find a Python library for a specific task
Compare popular Python packages by downloads and stars
Discover web frameworks, data science or AI tools for Python
Look up a PyPI package's description and category
summary.what_it_does: The page is a searchable table of 528 curated Python projects across 74 categories, as described in the meta description. Each row lists the project name, category tag, PyPI download count, GitHub star count and descriptive tags. Users can press / to search, click tags to open a category, and click a row for details. Examples in the visible list include requests, fastapi, pandas, pytorch, and langchain. The visible rows show download counts and star counts; some rows show "External" instead of a star count.
notable: Shows PyPI download counts and GitHub stars side by side
Keyboard search (press /) and category tags for filtering
caveats: Some rows show 'External' instead of a star count, so star data is not available for every project
Only the visible portion of the list is shown in the page text, which is cut off partway through the table
Lists projects rather than offering a single tool; the page itself does not state a price or license
